news.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
news.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

news.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

news.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

news.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
news.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working.

news.title: Stripe says AI agent purchases are adding up, but it won't share the numbers
news.summary: AI agents are increasingly using Stripe's payment service Link to shop for their users, Upstarts Media reports.

news.title: The neocloud shakeout is coming, and Nvidia has the most to lose
news.summary: After stock crashes and Firmus's scrapped IPO, industry executives expect only seven to ten of the hundreds of AI cloud providers to survive.

news.title: Anthropic plans fund for workers threatened by AI, Musk counters with SpaceX shares for children
news.summary: Anthropic wants to put five percent of its shares into a new public benefit fund that will also look into direct payments to workers at risk of losing their jobs.

news.title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else

news.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says

news.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor.

news.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
news.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

news.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
news.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.
